name: Child of Nature
label: Quest
description: Child of Nature: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Have you heard of the Cenarion Circle? I'd expect not. They are an ancient order of naturalists and practitioners of the druidic arts, much like yourself. In the city of Stormwind you'll find a night elf by the name of Sheldras Moontree. He will teach you how to reach the stronghold of the Cenarion Circle on Kalimdor, a place called Moonglade.
Go now. You have much to learn if you wish to save your home.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Greetings, fellow adventurer. It pleases me to meet a fellow adventurer from among the Skyborne, and to be among the first to welcome you to Azeroth.
I think you will find that my fellow adventurers of the Cenarion Circle have much wisdom to impart upon you, child of nature.
